name: Trigger box
summary: A trigger box is a see-through box you place in a doorway. When someone walks into it, it can play beats, a sound, send them somewhere, sit them down or run a script. It does nothing until it is Armed and Gizmos live is on.
helps: Greet a friend when they walk in, once, and only them.
where2d: Atelier and BSA, right panel, Gizmos: Add trigger box.
whereVR: Wrist menu > Objects > Gizmos > Trigger box

d2: Open the right panel and find Gizmos. Press Add trigger box.
Drag it to the doorway and stretch it to fill the doorway.
Set Players to Guests only, When to Someone enters, and How often to Once per visitor.
Add what it starts, for example Play beats Greeting.
Turn Armed on, then turn Gizmos live on.
vr: Open the wrist menu and press Objects, then Gizmos, then Trigger box.
Put the box in the doorway and stretch it with the handles or with both hands.
Tap the box and set Players, When and How often. Add what it starts.
Press Test it to try it with nobody there.
Turn Armed on, then open Settings and turn Gizmos live on.
use: a trigger does nothing until it is Armed and Gizmos live is on
a new or copied trigger is not Armed
once per visitor means each friend only once while they are in the room
Hide gizmos hides the box and it keeps working
Photo and video leave the box out
only the host's page runs triggers, and a friend cannot change them.

changes.note: A trigger box now starts things when a friend walks in, so place one from Objects, Gizmos, set Guests only and Once per visitor, then turn Armed on and Gizmos live on.
